title: Green Woman in Surreal Dream
description: A green-skinned woman with long red hair stands in the center wearing a black dress with orange floral patterns. She is surrounded by large translucent bubbles containing faint faces, set against a surreal collage background featuring a stylized man's face on the right, suburban houses, and abstract painted elements on the ground.
prompt: A green-skinned woman with flowing red hair stands in the center of a surreal dreamlike scene, wearing a long black dress covered in bright orange flowers. She is surrounded by large iridescent bubbles containing ghostly faces. In the background, a stylized man with a mustache and hat appears on the right, suburban houses sit in the middle distance, and abstract painted figures float in the dark sky. Moody and atmospheric digital painting.
